title: Native Android app foundation and secure KYC workflow
notes: Added native Kotlin Android application source and APK/AAB build workflow.
Added private KYC document uploads, customer KYC status and admin review desk.
KYC-protected services use a server-side access check; manual review is active until an authorised verification provider is connected.
Original public homepage design and wording remain unchanged.
Live financial services remain in preview mode until real provider integrations and signed transaction verification are complete.
